Extract description from <meta name='description'> tag

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<html><head><title>Page</title><meta name="description" content="This is the page description."></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(extract_metadata: true))
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.metadata.document.description.inspect
```
